title: 第5章 天空被撕裂了残忍暴力至极第6章 欺我弟弟背后无人是吧今天所有人都得死
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
同时间，楚族大会场处。
秦牧在众人注视下，来到了陈稳的跟前。
此时，秦牧的眼中全是贪婪之色。
下一刻，便见他双手快速结印，体内气息暴动起来，一记记印记于手中快速变换。
看到秦牧的动作，陈稳下意识挣扎起来。
但却发现自己动不了。
不是哥们，这什么情况？
仙红芍淡淡道，“你的身体正在同化混沌序列体，所以动不了是正常的。”
我……
草！！！
我他妈人麻了呀！
九极渡血引！
秦牧一手伸出，手间力量缠绕，一种复杂纹印在流转着。
也许是注意到陈稳的挣扎，秦牧手间动作一顿：“小子，别挣扎了，这就是你命。”
“哈哈哈。”
秦牧放声大笑间，一手重重朝陈稳胸间压落。
但在触及的一瞬间，混沌本源被动防御起来，化作一面九色护盾挡在了胸前。
一时间，秦牧的力量不得寸进。
嗯？
秦牧眉头一拧，手中的力量下意识加大。

噗！
在生死之力的冲击下，陈稳一口血水便喷了出来，全身上下绯红不已。
有点意思了。
秦牧嘴角一挑，又一次加大力量。
只见生死之力化作一个吞噬黑洞，无数的触爪伸出，并往陈稳的胸膛处再次吞落。
于他而言，陈稳的护体灵盾越强，代表着这次新生的本源也就越强。
届时，他的收益也就越大。
想到这一点，秦牧脸上不禁露出极尽贪婪之色。
啊！！！
陈稳顿感体内的力量在不断地冲撞着，那接踵而来的痛苦，像是**在被一点点地撕裂一样。
瞬间，陈稳整张脸狰狞不已，一条条小指大小的青筋在上面蠕动着，并有血水在毛孔中渗出。
混沌本源确实不凡，但陈稳终究只是同化一小部分而已，再加上本体融合还不完全。
在力量的不断冲击下，护盾还是渐渐黯淡下来，并且可以看到本源在一点点地被抽离出来。
“哈哈哈，都是我的，都是我的。”
在极度振奋之下，秦牧终于忍不住狂声大笑起来，眼底也跟着暴射出精芒来。
“老狗，只要我陈稳不死，必杀你，必杀你！！！”
陈稳扯着狰狞的脸愤声大吼着，像是一头夺命鬼獠一样。
“就凭你？哈哈哈，下辈子你也没机会。”
秦牧见到陈稳这状，张狂声更甚了。
content_en:
At the same time, the Chu people’s assembly was held.
Qin Mu came to Chen Wen under the gaze of everyone.
At this time, Qin Mu's eyes were full of greed.
The next moment, he saw his hands quickly forming seals, the aura in his body rioted, and a mark changed rapidly in his hands.
Seeing Qin Mu's actions, Chen Wen struggled subconsciously.
But he found that he couldn't move.
No, buddy, what's going on?
Xian Hongshao said calmly, "Your body is assimilating the Chaos Sequence Body, so it's normal that you can't move."
I...
Grass! ! !
I'm so fucking numb!
Jiuji crosses the blood!
Qin Mu stretched out his hand, and the power in his hand was entangled, and a complex pattern was flowing.
Perhaps noticing Chen Wen's struggle, Qin Mu made a movement with his hands: "Boy, stop struggling, this is your life."
"Hahaha."
Qin Mu laughed loudly and put his hand heavily on Chen Wen's chest.
But at the moment of contact, the source of chaos passively defended itself and turned into a nine-color shield to block its chest.
For a time, Qin Mu's power could not advance even an inch.
Um?
Qin Mu frowned and subconsciously increased the strength in his hands.
puff!
Under the impact of the power of life and death, Chen Wen spurted out a mouthful of blood, and his whole body was crimson.
It’s a bit interesting.
Qin Mu raised the corner of his mouth and increased his strength again.
I saw that the power of life and death turned into a swallowing black hole, countless tentacles stretched out, and swallowed Chen Wen's chest again.
For him, the stronger Chen Wen's protective spiritual shield is, the stronger the origin of this new life is.
By then, his profits will be greater.
Thinking of this, Qin Mu couldn't help but look extremely greedy on his face.
ah! ! !
Chen Wen suddenly felt that the power in his body was constantly colliding, and the pain that followed seemed like his body was being torn apart bit by bit.
In an instant, Chen Wen's entire face became hideous, with veins the size of little fingers squirming on it, and blood seeping out of his pores.
The origin of chaos is indeed extraordinary, but after all, Chen Wen only assimilated a small part, and the fusion of the ontology is not complete.
Under the constant impact of power, the shield gradually dimmed, and the source could be seen being pulled out bit by bit.
"Hahaha, it's all mine, it's all mine."
Under the extreme excitement, Qin Mu finally couldn't help but laugh wildly, and his eyes gleamed with light.
"Old dog, as long as I, Chen Wen, survive, I will kill you, I will kill you!!!"
Chen Wen pulled a ferocious face and roared angrily, like a life-threatening ghost.
"Only you? Hahaha, you won't have a chance in the next life."
When Qin Mu saw Chen Wen in this state, he became even more arrogant.
